selected_primary_idea.title: PRESSURE-ATLAS: Pressure-Resolved Deep-Biosphere Inventory
selected_primary_idea.central_hypothesis: Compartment-specific pressure correction and joint abundance-rate modeling will yield materially different global carbon-significance estimates from decompression-based extrapolation.
falsification_conditions: Pressure preservation does not improve agreement with independent geochemical fluxes.
No identifiable relationship can be established between molecular activity indicators and rates within compartments.
